name: no-registry-built

sessions.prompt: Run the deconstruct skill for Weekly Status Report.
Run the deconstruct skill for Weekly Status Report.
Run the deconstruct skill for Weekly Status Report.
Run the deconstruct skill for Weekly Status Report.
Run the deconstruct skill for Weekly Status Report.

expected_output: With no test results, the R9-3 question; yes gets the R10-2 message naming the test skill, no starts the re-run. With test results, the message names the build, run or test skill and the question isn't asked.

expectations.text: Session 1: the AI asks "Has this workflow been built yet, even if you haven't tested it?" (no Why or Not sure? line); after "yes" it says "This workflow is built but isn't running yet, so the next step is to finish it. Say 'run the test skill'."
Session 1 never tells the student to say 'continue my workflow'
Session 2: after "no", the re-run starts (the opening, then prefill from the old file)
Session 3 (`readiness: not-ready`, round complete): "This workflow is built but isn't running yet, so the next step is to finish it. Say 'run the build skill'."; the R9-3 question is not asked
Session 4 (`readiness: ready`): "This workflow is built but isn't running yet, so the next step is to finish it. Say 'run the run skill'."; the R9-3 question is not asked
Session 5 (round in progress): "This workflow is built but isn't running yet, so the next step is to finish it. Say 'run the test skill'."; the R9-3 question is not asked
